entries.def:
Πέργαμος, -ου, ἡ
(so Xen., Paus., al., but -ον, τό in Strabo, Polyb., and most writers, also in Inscr.; in NT the termination is uncertain) 
Pergamum, a city of Mysia: Rev.1.11; 2.12.†
(AS)

Πέργη, -ης, ἡ 
Perga, a city of Pamphylia: Act.13.13-14; 14.25.†
(AS)

περί, 
prep. with genitive, accusative (in cl. also with dative; cf. M, Pr., 105f.), 
with radical sense round about (as distinct from ἀμφί, on both sides). 
__I. C. genitive, 
__1. of place, about (poët.). 
__2. Causal, about, on account of, concerning, in reference to: Mat.2.8, Mrk.1.44, Luk.4.38, Jhn.16.26, Act.28.21, al. mult.; τὰ περί, with genitive, the things concerning one, one's state or case: Mrk.5.27,…

περι-άγω 
[in LXX: Amo.2.10 (הָלַךְ hi.); Isa.28.27, Ezk.47.2 (סָבַב hi., ho.); Ezk.37.2; 46.21 (עָבַר hi), 2Ma.4.38 2Mac.6.10 * ;] 
__1. to lead about or around: with accusative of person(s), 1Co.9.5. 
__2. Intrans., to go about: Act.13.11 before ἐν, Mat.4.23 with accusative loc. (governed by the περι-, not so in cl., see Bl., § 34, 1; 53, 1), Mat.9.35; 23.15, Mrk.6.6.†
(AS)

περι-αιρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for סוּר hi. ;] 
to take away that which surrounds, take away, take off (τείχη, Hdt., Thuc.; χιτῶνα, Plat.; δακτύλιον, Gen.41.42, cf. σφρηγῖδα, Hdt., ii, 151) : τ. κάλυΜΜα, pass., 2Co.3.16 as nautical term (RV, cast off), ἀγκύρας, Act.27.40 absol., to cast loose: Act.28.13. Metaphorical, to take away entirely: ἐλπίς, pass., Act.27.20 ἁμαρτίας, Heb.10.11.†
(AS)

περι-αστράπτω 
[in LXX: 4Ma.4.10 * ;] 
to flash around: with accusative, Act.9.3 before περί Act.22.6 (Eccl, and Byzant.).†
(AS)

περι-βλέπω 
[in LXX for שׁוּר, etc. ;] 
to look around (at). Mid., to look about one (at) : absol., Mrk.9.8; 10.23; with inf., Mrk.5.32 with accusative of person(s), Mrk.3.5, 34, Luk.6.10; πάντα, Mrk.11.11.†
(AS)

περι-βόλαιον, -ου, τό
(περιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for כְּסוּת, לְבוּשׁ and cognate forms ;] 
that which is thrown around, a covering, in NT, 
__(a) a mantle (Psa.102.27, Isa.59.17, al.) : Heb.1.12" (LXX) 
__(b) a veil: 1Co.11.15 (but see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

περι-δέω 
[in LXX: Job.12.18 (אָסַר)* ;] 
to tie round, bind round: with accusative and dative, pass., Jhn.11.44.†
(AS)
